task.description: WF-03 Step 4 (regression test) for ISS-0699. On branch feature/WF03-ISS0699-20260917. This repo has NO Elixir/mix-test surface here -- the fix is entirely in scripts/test_parallel.sh (bash). Follow the established shell-test convention: test/scripts/test_parallel_pool_sizing_test.sh and test/scripts/test_parallel_create_burst_test.sh are the precedent (standalone bash test scripts under test/scripts/, POSIX-friendly assertions, explicit PASS/FAIL summary, process exit code 0/1). Write test/scripts/test_parallel_tmpdir_cleanup_test.sh that proves the fix -- it must FAIL against the PRE-FIX script and PASS against the POST-FIX script (fail-then-pass proof, per WF-03's own test-design requirement). Since a full real invocation of test_parallel.sh needs mix/postgres (not available in this environment per ELIXIR-DEV's own note), do NOT require a real mix test run: instead, directly test the trap/cleanup MECHANISM by extracting and exercising it in isolation (same technique as test_parallel_pool_sizing_test.sh's own extraction approach -- source or eval the relevant block from the real script in a controlled subshell/fixture that fakes a fast exit without running mix), covering at minimum: (a) a simulated clean exit (exit 0) with TEST_PARALLEL_KEEP_LOGS unset -- tmp_dir removed; (b) a simulated clean exit with TEST_PARALLEL_KEEP_LOGS set -- tmp_dir preserved; (c) a simulated failing exit (non-zero) -- tmp_dir preserved regardless of TEST_PARALLEL_KEEP_LOGS. Run it yourself against BOTH the pre-fix commit (git show main:scripts/test_parallel.sh, or checkout main's copy via TEST_PARALLEL_SCRIPT=<path to a pre-fix copy>) and the current post-fix branch, and record both results in result.summary as the fail-then-pass proof. Do not run the tests yet in the sense of TEST-RUNNER's own independent step -- but you must demonstrate the fail-then-pass property yourself as design evidence, per WF-03 Step 4's own rule. Claim by setting status to IN_PROGRESS.

Tests the real mechanism (extracted/sourced from the actual script, not a hand-duplicated copy of the logic) per this repo's own established precedent
